story.fullStory:
Glass Tiger's "Don't Forget Me When I'm Gone" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Don't Forget Me (When I'm Gone)" is a song by Canadian rock band Glass Tiger.

It was released in 1986 as the lead from their debut album, The Thin Red Line (1986).

The song reached number one in Canada and number two in the United States.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.
